tailoring.headline: B2B Commerce Architect | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, microservices and REST/OCC APIs, with deep experience designing and integrating PIM, ERP and MDM data flows. Proven record in API architecture, headless commerce, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and techno-functional analysis, translating business requirements into robust, scalable solutions for B2B commerce.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2B Commerce Architect
cover_en.hook: I am excited to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to Experis Portugal’s Salesforce B2B Commerce Architect role. My track record at Rockwell Automation and Shell delivering scalable B2B e-commerce platforms aligns with your need for robust commerce architecture.

bullets.label: Platform Architecture
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions on Hybris 2211, implementing Java/Spring microservices that underpin B2B commerce experiences, ensuring scalability and performance.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, delivering seamless data synchronization across global commerce channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories and functional specs, driving delivery of commerce features that meet precise B2B needs.

bullets.label: Agile & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker/Kubernetes, supporting rapid releases and production stability in agile Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit, currently serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Experis Portugal.

tailoring.why_company: Experis Portugal is a leading digital transformation partner that empowers enterprises to modernize their commerce ecosystems. I am drawn to your commitment to innovative B2B solutions and the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies across Europe. My deep experience in architecting scalable SAP Commerce platforms aligns with your vision to deliver robust, integrated commerce experiences for clients, and I am eager to contribute to your high-impact projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to design scalable B2B commerce architectures that drive client success at Experis Portugal.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years building B2B e-commerce platforms. I’m interested in the Salesforce B2B Commerce Architect role at Experis Portugal and would love to discuss how my integration and architecture experience can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Salesforce B2B Commerce Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce B2B Commerce Architect position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, Spring, API and integration expertise, as well as proven techno-functional leadership. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and will be available from 16 December 2026.
